Name: Silverdale Waterfront Park
Info: Access to the southern terminus of the Clear Creek Trail can be found at the Silverdale Waterfront Park. Park along Washington Ave NW.

Name: Old Mill Park
Info: Old Mill Park is located on Bucklin Hill Road between Silverdale Way and Tracyton Boulevard. Parking is available near the restroom.

Name: Clear Creek Sa'qad Interpretive Center
Info: Located in the red barn at Creekside Office Park. Access via Bucklin Hill Road to Levin Road. Weekend parking available in office lot; weekdays use Old Mill Park.

Name: Ridgetop Pavillion
Info: The Ridgetop Pavillion is located adjacent to 9228 Ridgetop Blvd. This lot is only open on weekends.

Name: All Star Lanes Trailhead
Info: Trailhead is located at the northeast corner of the bowling alley parking lot. Access multiple trail loops leading to Silverdale Way, Myhre Road, and Hospital Hill.

Name: Silverdale Rotary Gateway Park
Info: Also known as the Silverdale Rotary Gateway Park, this public parking area is for the dog park, skateboard park, and north wetlands trails. Expect overflow parking on Silverdale Way during peak times.

Name: Schold Road Trailhead
Info: Access via Silverdale Way to Schold Place then left onto a quiet neighborhood Schold Road. Park on gravel shoulders. Turnaround available at dead end.

Name: Trigger Ave
Info: Access to the northern terminus of the Clear Creek Trail can be found near Petersen Farm. Park on the road right-of-way.
